copy.curiosityHook: When every lesson teaches you to suspect everyone around you, how do you know which test is real?
copy.description: At the CIA's secluded training facility known as the Farm, a sharp recruit faces grueling preparation where instinct is tested and survival means questioning every ally.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, paranoid, and steadily paced action-thriller viewing built on suspicion and sharp focus.
copy.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson crafts a sharp, suspenseful spy thriller driven by the constant psychological friction of high-stakes intelligence training.

allowedMaterial: Initial environment of suspicion where nobody can be trusted
excludedMaterial: Specific mole reveals or hidden loyalties
